description: Find live radio stations in Airtune's catalogue of 50,000+ stations from 200+ countries. Search by name (typo-tolerant) and/or filter by country, genre, mood or language. With no query, returns the most popular stations matching the filters. Returns each station's slug (needed by the other tools) and its Airtune page URL, where the user can listen.

genre.description: Genre tag, e.g. "jazz". The main genres, with the most stations: classical, country, dance, electronic, folk, hip-hop, jazz, news, pop, religious, rock, talk. The filter matches a station tag exactly, so some other common tags also work ("ambient", "lofi", "top40") with fewer stations, but spelling matters: "smooth-jazz" matches nothing. If a genre returns no stations, use the closest main genre or put the style in `query` instead of guessing another tag.

locale.description: Language for country, genre and language names (ISO 639-1). Default: en.

mood.description: Mood id, one of: chill, energetic, focus, relax, happy, sleep. Any other value matches no station. For a mood not in this list, use the closest one, or describe the style with `genre` or `query`.

query.description: Station name or part of it, e.g. "BBC Radio 1" or "kexp".

name: search_stations
title: Search radio stations
